# Ninepenny Ridge Observatory - reading archive

One reading per instrument per minute lands in the archive.
The window expressions the data team reviewed are carded in sql/window-clauses.tsv.

turns.prompt: Ninepenny Ridge Observatory files one reading per instrument per minute. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
